`class GifResourceAnimationReader`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IResourceAnimationReader`](/reference/resources/iresourceanimationreader/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.animation.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [GifResourceAnimationReader.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/animation/impl/GifResourceAnimationReader.java)

Reads the frames of a GIF.

## Description

A frame delay of 10 ms or less shows for 100 ms, as browsers do; the play count comes from the loop extension of the file, otherwise one play.
